metadata.comparisonRule: The fixture contains only name, construction, rhoFeatures, phi, initialClusters, trainingEmbeddings, expectedGamma, expectedPi, expectedElbos, and expectedIterationCount per case. Tensor values use the existing exact IEEE-754 little-endian float64 encoding; the portable comparison tolerance for computed gamma/pi/ELBO values is maximum absolute error 1e-6, and downstream centroid comparisons use maximum absolute error 1e-9. expectedIterationCount equals expectedElbos.shape[0]. Gamma must have N rows and K columns, pi must have K entries, all outputs must be finite, and each case must execute 2 through 20 iterations. The fixed set must include both an exactly-20-iteration case and an early-converging case; collapsed-pi must have minimum pi below 1e-7. No model paths or model binaries are stored in fixture metadata.
metadata.inputConstruction: Every expected value is observed from the pinned FluidAudio 0.15.8 revision 87a39dfe4068fef0f1c69bfe704b2b3ef4fbc5bc VBxClustering.refine(rhoFeatures:initialClusters:) call with DiarizationParityOracle.config(). No model assets are loaded and no inference is run. PLDATransform receives a plain MLModel() only as the inert constructor holder required by its API; VBxClustering.refine reads only PLDATransform.phiParameters (VBxClustering.swift:72-77; PLDATransform.swift:17-22). The synthetic-k2 through synthetic-k8 cases use N=3*K, D=128, E=256, with labels[row]=row%K, prescribed synthetic rho features and positive decaying phi values; their stored training embeddings use the unchanged normalized synthetic embedding construction. Scalar-x3/x4/x4.5/x5 retain their fixed one-dimensional convergence-stress inputs, and collapsed-pi retains its fixed 128-dimensional collapsed-prior input. Cases are ordered synthetic-k2 through synthetic-k8, scalar-x3/x4/x4.5/x5, collapsed-pi.
